What should you look for when it activates?
How is it useful during a chase?
Does Evil Presence require Stalk Tier 3?
How do you unlock it / what is still unknown?
What other Michael abilities / traits are confirmed?

claims.claim: Evil Presence is an unlockable Michael ability observed in Early Access multiplayer gameplay (selectable Michael ability slot, not one of the two official starting traits).
claims.capture_purpose: Evil Presence ability name / activation in Michael loadout or HUD during EA gameplay

claims.claim: Observed EA gameplay shows Evil Presence as a short-range area/aura around Michael that visibly staggers or interrupts nearby Civilians' movement.
claims.capture_purpose: Michael short-range Evil Presence aura with nearby Civilian stagger / movement interruption

claims.claim: The observed stagger/interruption can create an opening for Michael to close distance or interrupt an escape attempt.
claims.applicability: Early Access multiplayer footage — Middi; usefulness inference from visible interruption only
claims.capture_purpose: Chase moment where Evil Presence stagger lets Michael close distance or cut off escape

claims.claim: Some players report that Evil Presence can make Civilians trip or fall; this remains community-reported and is not proven as a guaranteed trip mechanic.
claims.applicability: Community reports Sep 2026; distinguish from video-observed stagger

claims.claim: Some players describe a Tier 3 Stalk → chase → Evil Presence → execution sequence; this is community-reported play order, not a hard requirement that Evil Presence needs Stalk Tier 3 or guarantees an execution.

Official materials do not publish Evil Presence's exact Killer Level, cooldown, range, duration, damage, probability, blood/resource cost, formal Chase State requirement, Stalk Tier 3 requirement, or Bloodthirst interaction — treat those fields as launch verification pending.
claims.applicability: Official progression/customization overview as of research pack; values remain known unknowns

claims.claim: Michael loadouts have 2 starting traits (Killer Sense + Shape Jump); players separately choose 3 Michael abilities; Killer progression unlocks new Michael abilities.

Official multiplayer overview documents Michael's core kit including Killer Sense (prey awareness), Stalk (focus builds tracking and stronger execution opportunities), Shape Jump (shadow mobility with darkness/LOS enter-exit constraints), Shape Dash from Shape Jump, blackouts/light manipulation, and melee combat where Civilians can resist and Michael cannot simply be killed.
Xander noob footage shows short stun/stagger gameplay near Michael but cannot cleanly prove that effect is Evil Presence; use only as secondary context, not core Evil Presence proof.
claims.applicability: Secondary context only — Middi remains primary Evil Presence proof
claims.capture_purpose: Short stun/stagger near Michael as secondary context (not labeled Evil Presence proof)

evidence_items.summary: Official IllFonic progression/customization overview: Michael loadout has 2 starting traits (Killer Sense + Shape Jump) plus 3 selectable Michael abilities; Killer progression unlocks new Michael abilities. Does not publish Evil Presence numeric values.
evidence_items.limitations: Does not name Evil Presence or publish unlock level / cooldown / range.

evidence_items.summary: Official multiplayer gameplay overview for Michael / Stalk / Shape Jump / blackouts / combat resistance boundaries.

Middi — The BEST Ability On Myers In Halloween The Game (Evil Presence). EA gameplay explicitly discusses and uses Evil Presence; short-range aura around Michael with nearby Civilian stagger/movement interruption.
evidence_items.limitations: Verbal cooldown/blood numbers are unreliable and must not become exact mechanics. Early Access build.

evidence_items.summary: Xander noob — MICHAEL MYERS' NEW ABILITY | Halloween: The Game. Secondary context for short stun/stagger gameplay; cannot cleanly prove Evil Presence.

evidence_items.summary: Player reports: Evil Presence may make Civilians trip/fall; some describe Tier 3 Stalk → chase → Evil Presence → execution. Keep COMMUNITY_CORROBORATED only.
